text:
tomas: Quick thought 1 Can we push "warmup" execution down into the runtime agent instead of having the central orchestrator do all priming? Agent-local prefetch + KV priming could cut node-to-node transfers and lower orchestration churn.

maya: I like less churn. Main worry: cross-tenant noisy warmups on shared nodes. How do we keep one tenant from starving others?

alex_chen: Proposal sketch: operator remains authoritative for policy and budgets. Operator issues tenant-scoped warmup leases to agents; agents execute under local soft-quotas and per-tenant rate limits. Example lease proto: `tenant_id:T123 model:resnet-xl budget_tokens:50 cancelable:true max_concurrent:2`. Agent reports progress and either finishes or returns partial credit. If local capacity low agent defers back to operator.

infra-bot: deploy-check: warmup-agent-proto passes static checks.

sean: Security/billing note 1 moving exec to agents increases attack surface. Need strong throttles and billing integration so tenants can't spam warmups. Warmup units should be billed or deducted from tenant budgets.

maya: Also need drain/eviction handling. If node drained mid-warmup we need cancel + refund so tenants don't lose credits.

tomas: Agreed. Make leases cancelable with a short refund-window TTL and a `progress_pct`. Refund math: `refund = floor(budget_tokens * (1 - progress_pct))` or similar. Agent returns `warmup_progress_pct` and `warmup_refund_tokens`.

alex_chen: Metrics to add: `agent_warmup_queue_length`, `warmup_progress_pct`, `warmup_refund_tokens`, `warmup_retries`. Operator dashboard can alert on excess refunds (oscillation).

pranav: I'll prototype a simulator that toggles node capacity and injects drains to validate refund calculation and ensure we don't oscillate warmup credits. Can test various refund windows and RTTs.

tomas: Operationally operator keeps policy + billing; agents are execution-only and must enforce local safeties. I'll draft a short RFC with sequence diagrams, lease proto, and sim plan.

maya: TL;DR: operator issues budgets, agents execute under caps, leases cancelable with refund math + metrics + sim. Sounds good to me.

tomas: I'll post the RFC later today and loop in eng-sre for chaos testing. :rocket:
